Anees vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. on 16
January, 2024
Author: Pankaj Bhatia

Bench: Pankaj Bhatia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:4313
Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 461 of 2024
Applicant :- Anees

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Sheo Prakash Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.43 of 2022 under sections 376, 504, 506, 452 IPC, P.S. Inhouna, District Amethi.

3. The FIR in question was lodged through an application under sections 156(3) Cr.P.C. alleging that on 20.06.2022 at about 05:00 pm, the applicant had committed the offence under the threat of making the video viral.
The FIR itself was lodged on 31.12.2022 i.e. after about six months of the alleged incident.

Anees vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76106642/
1 4.

entities.text: Anees vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The submission of the counsel for the applicant is that the entire case is based upon the allegations that the offence was committed by issuance of a threat of making the video viral whereas no video, audio or photographs have been allegedly recovered so as to link the applicant with the offence in question and the victim is aged about 30 years.
The applicant has no criminal history.

5. Considering the inordinate delay in lodging the FIR coupled with the fact that no recovery of mobile etc. has been recovered from the applicant, the applicant who has no criminal history and is in custody since 16.02.2023, the applicant is entitled for the bail.
Thus the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Anees be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.25000/- (Twenty Five Thousand)
each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 16.1.2024 VNP/-
 
Anees vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
